exposure: Hearing screening with a two-staged AABR screening protocol
cohort: 4512 newborns hospitalized in the neonatology department
finding: Prematurity and low birthweight increased the rate of false-positivity in hearing screening, and the chronological age at the time of the test seems to be significantly associated with false-positivity.
mod_finding: The study did not show a clear association between the mode of delivery and false-positivity.
